heading: Paisley Panthers
narrative:
- Derek -
He lives in England. He went 17-40 during the 3 seasons with us (2010-12) and never made a Playoff appearance. Derek did make a Jamarcus Russel Bowl but didn't get the trophy. Somehow he holds a record for a player with the Most Points in a Game (Doug "Muscle Hampster" Martin). This team is on a 5 year drought of Playoffs with the 2 Panthers. He is in the record books with a win in the closest game by beating Creston by .05 points.
